correctness.rationale: For sorted pairwise-prime-base prime-power components Q_i, the indexed 2^r weights ∏(Q_i−1) over unitary subsets total M_r. Necessity: a violated Q_i>M_(i−1)+2 leaves M_(i−1)+1 unrepresentable; sufficiency: old complete subset sums 0..M duplicate under factor Q_i−1, covering successive intervals exactly iff Q_i−1≤M+1. Greedy recursion G_i=G_(i−1)(G_(i−1)+2)=2^(2^i)−1 and strict monotonicity force first five Fermat primes (3,5,17,257,65537) at equality. If M5<G5 then M6≤G5²−1<N. Otherwise the sixth prime power Q6≤2^32+1; this number factors as 641·6700417 (distinct primes), so Q6≤2^32. That bound is attained by the distinct-base power 2^32; uniqueness follows. Independent exact subset-sum comparison on 472 small prime-power configurations and integer products supports, but infinite quantifiers rest on the induction.
residual_risks: Only maximum at exactly six distinct prime bases; no exhaustive classification or maxima beyond six supports. Finite checks not an infinite proof.
